commit.message:
Reorganise figures/landscape/ around the manuscript's own numbering

Replace the legacy per-tissue tree with one runnable script per manuscript
figure, ported from the reproduction pipeline. 94 panels across 17 figures and
31 of the 36 numbered supplementary sub-tables.

A main figure and its Extended Data supplement share a folder, because they are
usually one computation split across two figure numbers: six helper files were
read by both. Each folder carries that pair's scripts, its ST*.R tables, its
*_helpers.R, any *_fit.R with the .env that configures it, and its sources/.

config/panel_map.json and config/table_map.json are authoritative for the
numbering. A script reads its own output path, page size and RNG seed from the
manifest, so renumbering a panel is an edit to one JSON file.

Each panel is a zero-argument function and run_panels() runs them, so the data
load at the top of a figure script happens once for the whole figure and a
single panel can still be rebuilt on its own. run_tables() does the same for
sub-tables. Nineteen of the 31 sub-tables are written by a figure script rather
than a table script, because their numbers are a panel's numbers.

Three panels read individual-level data that is not in this repository and may
not be published. ED1A, ED3D and ED3E report that and skip; the rest of their
figure still builds. Those inputs are gitignored by filename so a local copy
cannot be committed. Sixteen panels read one of the four fits and skip with the
command that produces it until it has been run.

run_all.R builds everything, each script in its own process, and writes
outputs/run_report.tsv. The four fits are opt-in behind --fits.

assembled/ carries the figures and tables as submitted, with a README stating
that panels come from these scripts and were re-typeset in Illustrator without
any value or graphical element changing.
